title: Postcards and Language
author: Ulyana Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
